title: The Steel Emperor
summary: The Steel Emperor Manhwa ​Heroes of Gauri, Conquer Another World! The most glorious name in this land, Gauri. ​The one who protected that name. People call him the Steel Emperor! ​The last Great General of the fallen Gauri (Goguryeo), “Go Jincheon.” At the moment of their fall, he and his elite unit, the ‘Black-Armored Demon Cavalry’, fall into another world. ​A strange land where various races such as Elves, Orcs, Dwarves, and Wizards live. ​If they cannot return There is no choice but to establish a new Gauri. Go Jincheon raises his banner once more for the conquest of the continent. 강철의 열제, The Iron Emperor
